page_title: STU 2-1 RBL | Stuttgart v RB Leipzig 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
90+4' El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Peter Gulacsi pulls off a great save to deny Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card! It's his second one today, which means he will be send off!
88' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

87' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Stuttgart force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
86' Having seen unsporting behavior, Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And David Raum (RB Leipzig) is the recipient.

85' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
83' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Fuhrich leaves the pitch and Yannik Keitel (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
82' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
78' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.

77' My Gran could have done better! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
75' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Nick Woltemade is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
75' Substitution. Deniz Undav will be replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
75' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
73' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
70' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin Kampl.
70' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Lukas Klostermann will be replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
70' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.

68' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sascha Stegemann with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' Substitution. Xavi Simons is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
66' Substitution. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as David Raum walks off.

66' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
63' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Ameen Al Dakhil and he is replaced by Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
63' Substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Jacob Bruun Larsen.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 2:1.

60' Peter Gulacsi was forced into action to thwart Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.

57' A sweet pass inside the box gives Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
56' Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart).
55' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
54' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the right post. 1:1.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by David Raum (RB Leipzig), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle as Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Dangerous play by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart). Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' One of the players from RB Leipzig times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+1' Yellow card. Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Sascha Stegemann stops the game and makes a call.

42' A precise low pass is received by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.

37' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Alexander Nubel, who pulls off a stunning save!
36' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. 61:39 – the latest ball possession ratio.
33' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
32' Sascha Stegemann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) and blew his whistle.
31' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
27' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

24' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Peter Gulacsi anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
23' David Raum (RB Leipzig) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
23' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' The game is interrupted now, Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Flag up against David Raum (RB Leipzig). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
17' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
16' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will take a corner kick.
16' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Stuttgart win a corner.
15' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
13' The attendance for today's match is 57500.
10' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) was set free in the area by Xavi Simons and fired past Alexander Nubel. 0:1.
10' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul after dangerous play.
9' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
8' David Raum (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
7' It looks like Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

7' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
6' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
5' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
1' David Raum (RB Leipzig) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Sascha Stegemann will officiate today.
